description: ATM407 mass-flux SCM reference, generated with the configuration as it now stands (scm/configs/atm407.toml). Includes dry convective adjustment, mass-weighted optical depth for well-mixed gases, compensating-subsidence drying in the mass-flux scheme, diagnosed boundary-layer depth, and convective downdrafts. Cloud radiative effects are off in this baseline. Surface imbalance (0.04 W/m2), temperature drift (0.0008 K) and column energy residual (0.0008) are all excellent; equilibrium_passed is False only on TOA imbalance (1.36 against a 1.0 threshold). Known limitation: about 30% of column mass sits at or above 95% RH, a saturated layer between roughly 685 and 865 hPa, because condensation is a grid-mean saturation adjustment. The subgrid replacement for it is implemented but not working and is disabled (condensation_rh_crit = 1.0); see docs/column_open_problems.md.
